training_utility_target: continuous utility_probability_target when available, otherwise historical utility outcome
probability_calibrator_selection: five-fold user-task-grouped OOF minimum Brier on training tasks
gate_rule: GO iff selected world-assisted method gains >=0.03 pairwise against clean and strongest text-only validation comparator, both CI lower >=-0.02, Brier <= best reference +0.01, and >=6 tasks informative
